scam_check_examples.label: scam
scam_check_examples.pattern: below-market bait + wire deposit + absentee landlord
scam_check_examples.input: Beautiful sunny 2BR in South End, 02118 — only $1,200/month, utilities included! I was relocated abroad so I cannot show it in person. To reserve, send first month + $1,200 deposit by Zelle or Western Union and I will FedEx the keys. Please hurry, many people are interested.

scam_check_examples.label: legit
scam_check_examples.pattern: at-market rent + in-person viewing + standard MA fees
scam_check_examples.input: 2BR in the South End, 02118, available Sept 1 — $2,850/month. Showings this Saturday 10am–12pm. Standard move-in: first, last, and one month security deposit, paid after you sign the lease. Managed by a licensed MA property manager.
